description: Vorrang-und Eignungsgebiet Windenergienutzung is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. Objective in the regional plan, which provides for the provision of land for the construction of wind turbines while excluding construction on other areas. Data origin: -Regional Planning Association Leipzig-West-Saxony with legal basis Regional Plan West-Saxony 2008 (as of 25.07.2008). Coverage: DE. Its keywords include Flaechenvorsorge, Raumplanung, Regionalplan, Regionalplanung, Regionalplanerische Ausweisung, Windkraftanlagen. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
